messages:
sophie: quick check — Optimize toolkit status? need final quantization recommendations + batching/caching defaults to share with sales by EOD. cc @maria

maria: can you scope — who owns final sign-off for recs vs defaults? i thought eng-ml for recs, eng-runtime for batching/caching finalization

aj: eng-ml will own the recs doc. i've got a PR (WIP) with per-model quant profiles for Llama2/Redwood-Base and a recommended fallback. waiting on runtime canary numbers before I mark as final

kyle: started the canary this morning (quant:v1-canary). initial numbers: p95 latency +5ms, throughput stable. seeing a ~12% KV cache miss spike at high concurrency — needs watching

cam: infra dependency: dedicated infra needs the 8-bit GEMM kernel patch applied on canary hosts. they estimated Wed AM to finish. until then full-scale canary is blocked

maria: thanks. ownership plan: @aj finalize recs doc, @kyle validate canary and confirm no perf regressions after infra patch, @cam confirm ETA & roll plan. I'll update roadmap and notify sales. Any other blockers for a Thu-Fri rollout window?

aj: one more ask — i need ~10 representative prompts/use-cases to run the quality evals. @sophie can you drop them here? :pray:

sophie: pasted quick prompts below (short customer-y queries + edge cases):
1) summarize last 3 commits and flag breaking changes
2) extract contact info from noisy text
3) rewrite marketing blurb for mobile audiences
4) multi-turn chat about billing with user corrections
5) code completion with interrupted context
6) paraphrase with length constraint (50-70 chars)
7) extract structured fields from receipts
8) safe-completion check for policy words
9) answer using only product docs (citation mode)
10) correct CSV parsing errors

deploy-bot: deploy: quant:v1-canary -> fleet subset (10%) — build 2026.03.17-1145 — starting rollout

kyle: canary update 30m in: tail latency stable, throughput same, memory +1.2GB under worst-case prompts. KV cache miss rate down to 9% after small config tweak. will keep monitoring for 3h

maria: batching/caching defaults proposal (draft):
```
batching:
  default_max_batch_size: 8
  max_latency_ms: 20
caching:
  kv_cache_prefetch: true
  prefix_cache_ttl_sec: 300
```
these are conservative — eng-runtime please weigh in

kyle: those defaults look reasonable. two notes: 1) we should gate prefetch with available memory check, 2) add a safety fallback to disable prefetch if cache miss spikes >15%

cam: infra ETA confirmed Wed 09:30 PT for kernel patch. i'll post host list and maintenance window in the infra channel. no other infra blockers from our side

aj: merging PR after a tiny lint fix. i'll publish the recs doc to the docs repo and link here once done

maria: i'll open a rollout ticket and schedule canary expansion to 50% after a clean 6h window. if no regression by 18:00 PT we'll proceed with staged rollout. cc sales update: i'll send a note with the conservative defaults and expected unit-cost change

sophie: thanks everyone — i'll notify sales and ops, and follow up on any customer questions. ping me if you need example inputs changed

kyle: tagging note — watch for cache-miss alert group: infra/cache/kv-miss. i'll add a dashboard panel for quick ops checks

maria: great. action items summarized: @aj publish recs doc, @kyle monitor canary + dashboard, @cam confirm infra patch done, @maria open rollout ticket + notify sales, @sophie provide any extra prompts if requested.

sophie: acked. :thumbsup:
